extra:
## This work (Р-183, stage 2; Р-128, Р-133, Р-134)

- Your scenario is one part of Pulp Cthulhu. Make it runnable from the knowledge base alone, as the scenarios of «Побег из Иннсмута» are (models below): scenario record (`summary`, `keeper_info`, `hook`, `advice`, `steps` with `refs`, `conclusion`, `tables`), every scene retold fully for play (`arc` = {scenario, part, order}), items, handouts (the player text as printed, in translation), organizations if the scenario has its own.
- Ids and folders: everything is book-scoped — `pulp-cthulhu-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/pulp-cthulhu-en/<kinds>/<slug>.json`: scenarios, scenes, items, handouts, characters, creatures, organizations, and also **locations** (`kb/books/pulp-cthulhu-en/locations/`, id `pulp-cthulhu-en/location/<slug>`, `location_type` as in the schema, `part_of` another location of yours or null) — places of other cities are not merged into shared city records now; the owner decides that later (Р-183).
- Maps: if the scenario has a map or plan, make a `map` record `pulp-cthulhu-en/map/<slug>` without spots and without an image file (the image is added later by the lead); describe in `quality.notes` what the map shows and on which page.
- Handouts of chapter 14 (pp. 235–253): take only those of your scenario (their captions name it: «Handout: Disintegrator 1», «Pandora’s Box 5»…), one `handout` record each, with `text` as printed (translated) and `refs` to where it is found.
- Characters: full statblocks as printed (Р-25), pulp talents as `refs` to `coc:talent:*` (they exist in kb/talents), `axes.ruleset: "pulp"`. Known Mythos creatures — refs/instance_of to existing `coc:creature:*`; a villain of ch. 9 that appears in your scenario — link to `pulp-cthulhu-en/character/<slug>` (they exist), do not duplicate.
- Rules the scenario uses — link `coc:rule:*` / `coc:rule:pulp-*` (exist). Spells, tomes, weapons — link existing records; new ones you need — create in the book folder (`pulp-cthulhu-en/spell/…` is not allowed: spells are global — put a new spell's full text into the scenario or character and list it in the report).
- English book: Russian text is our translation (`translated`); terms — as in the base (skills, talents, archetypes, rules) and the owner's terminology registry `C:\_Hobby\_work\CoC-terminology-20261011\terminology\CoC_Terminology_Decisions.csv` (accepted rows first).
- Coverage: `checks/20261108-pulp/<your unit name>.md` — every heading → record, «не взято» with the reason.
